title: 第6章 神秘老头第7章 拜师
content_zh:
第一卷 重生归来 第六章 神秘老头
推开门的中年警察没发现气氛诡异，对陶泽西说“小陶，我们跟她去老树村核实一下。”说罢，又对着苏芮说“你看，我们现在就去老树村，如果是真的，那你就由你师父抚养了。”语气中再也不复之前的随便，反倒带着客气。
毕竟如果苏芮真的是那个人的徒弟的话，那前途真的是不可限量啊，现在巴结一下，让她时候想巴结都没机会啦，至于之前李福夫妇拜托他把苏芮交给他们抚养，早被他抛到脑后了。
苏芮意味深长的看了中年警察一眼，看来她猜测的没错，那个老人的身份的确不简单。
早在中年警察进来的时候就收回自己悠闲的表情了，又变成了一个悲伤可怜的小孤女。
“好吧，我们现在就去找我师父，我不要让李福他们抚养！”苏芮抬起头，露出倔强的脸庞。
中年警察心中产生了一丝愧疚，多么坚强的小孩啊，该死的李福居然还贪图人家父母的赔偿金，真是畜生不如！他丝毫不记得李福让他帮忙而塞给了他一百块钱的事了。
陶泽西的在心中为中年警察默默的点上一根蜡烛。
这丫头太能演了，装的太逼真，让他都着了她的道，心中的小人早已泪流满面。
苏芮淡淡的瞥了一眼陶泽西，然后跟在中年警察后面走出病房，陶泽西接收到苏芮的信息，马上收起苦逼的表情，恢复成原本的玩世不恭，追出了病房。
经过一路颠簸，他们终于到了老树村。
“小陶，你去村子里大听一下李福家的人品，我和苏芮去后山。”说完带着苏芮就往后山走。
苏芮转过头，给陶泽西一个你知道怎么做的眼神，然后就跟在中年警察的后面去了后山。
陶泽西很无语，不过已经答应人家了，当然不能说话不算数，去村子里调查只是走一个过场而已。该怎么说他早就知道，那就是尽力抹黑李福夫妇。不过还是要去村子里做做样子的。
不过真是出乎他预料，李福夫妇在老树村早已引起众怒了，这个小媳妇，那个老婶子，东一嘴西一嘴的把李福和王春花做的坏事都抖搂出来了。什么偷邻居家菜园子里的菜啊。偷李嫂子家下蛋的母鸡啊。给别人家看瓜田的狗下药啊。李福以前还偷过厂子里的废铁。而王春花最喜欢占便宜了。其他嫁出去的女人都是从夫家往娘家弄好东西，可她不一样，她是总往自己家弄东西。以至于王老爹发话了，除非过年，否则永远别再会娘家，就算回来也不会让她进门，这就相当于不认这个女儿了。谁叫她把买给小侄子的麦乳精偷了给自己儿子喝呢。这叫活该。
这下，不用陶泽西添油加醋了，这对夫妇太极品了，还真是应了那句话，不是一家人，不进一家门啊。
再说苏芮那边，他们到了后山脚下，看见那遗世独立的四合院，让苏芮仿佛又回到了那个古老的充满了传奇色彩的古都京城。
那四合院修的不大，但是却很有气势，显得十分高贵威严，让人不住的想要仰望。
苏芮露出怀念又痛苦的神色，想到去世的爷爷和外公对她的疼爱，心中对对吴家的恨意更深了。
而中年警察这辈子都没离开过乌市的人来说，又怎么会明白四合院的的美呢，所以他只是觉得这个宅子很漂亮而已。

看着这个宅子，中年警察心中更加肯定了老人的不凡，回过头看着苏芮说，“我们进去吧。”说罢，也不等苏芮的回答，就上前去敲门。
咚咚咚，“有人在家嘛？有人…”还没说完，朱红色的大门就
“敲什么敲！不知道老头我在午睡嘛，扰人清静，小心遭天谴！”老头生气的说。
中年警察面色尴尬，“咳咳，老先生，我是青木县派出所的警察王贵，我是来找您……”
“师傅！我爸妈去世了！我只有你这一个亲人了师傅！呜呜~”还没等他说完，就看到一道身影冲过去抱住老人。“师傅！不要不要我啊！我以后一定不调皮了，师傅啊师傅！求求你了~我一定不给您添麻烦，呜呜~”
老人推开苏芮，“我说你这丫头，怎么乱……”还没说完，在老人看到苏芮的脸是，露出惊喜的神色，马上改口“原来是你着丫头啊，你说什么？你父母去世了？哎，看来只能我们师徒两人相依为命了…”
苏芮惊讶老人变脸如此之快，同时松了一口气，没被拆穿就好。可是那个老头眼中的惊喜她看的清清楚楚，到底是什么让他那么惊喜呢？
“既然这样，那苏芮今天就跟你师父这里住一晚吧，回头我看看陶泽西的调查结果，然后等这个案子完结了，就可以把你父母的遗体接回来入土为安了，我就不进去了。”说完，中年警察恭敬的对老人告别之后，就离开了。只留这对伪师徒站在门口大眼瞪小眼。
－－－－－－题外话－－－－－－
终于见到师父啦。不过来捧场的人好少啊。

Volume 1: Rebirth and Return Chapter 6: The Mysterious Old Man
The middle-aged policeman who opened the door did not notice the strange atmosphere and said to Tao Zexi, "Xiao Tao, let's go to Laoshu Village with her to verify." After that, he said to Su Rui, "Look, we are going to Laoshu Village now. If it is true, then you will be raised by your master." His tone was no longer as casual as before, but more polite.
After all, if Su Rui is really that person's apprentice, then the future is really limitless. Now if you try to fawn over her, she will never have a chance to fawn over you. As for the fact that Li Fu and his wife asked him to raise Su Rui to them, he has long forgotten about it.
Su Rui gave the middle-aged policeman a meaningful look. It seemed that her guess was correct. The old man's identity was indeed not simple.
As early as when the middle-aged policeman came in, he lost his leisurely expression and turned into a sad and pitiful little orphan again.
"Okay, let's go find my master now. I don't want Li Fu and the others to raise me!" Su Rui raised her head, showing a stubborn face.
The middle-aged policeman felt a trace of guilt in his heart. What a strong kid! Damn Li Fu actually covets his parents' compensation. He is really worse than a beast! He had no memory of Li Fu asking him to help and giving him a hundred yuan.
Tao Zexi silently lit a candle in his heart for the middle-aged policeman.
This girl was so good at acting and pretended to be so lifelike that he fell in love with her and the villain in his heart was already in tears.
Su Rui glanced at Tao Zexi lightly, and then followed the middle-aged policeman out of the ward. After receiving Su Rui's message, Tao Zexi immediately put away his bitter expression, returned to his original cynicism, and chased him out of the ward.
After a bumpy journey, they finally arrived at Laoshu Village.
"Xiao Tao, you go to the village and listen to the Li Fu family's character. Su Rui and I will go to the back mountain." After saying that, he took Su Rui and walked towards the back mountain.
Su Rui turned her head, gave Tao Zexi a know-how look, and then followed the middle-aged policeman to the back mountain.
Tao Zexi was speechless, but he had already promised, so of course he couldn't keep his promise. Going to the village to investigate was just a formality. What should I say? He already knew that he would try his best to discredit Li Fu and his wife. But I still have to go to the village to show off.
But it was beyond his expectation. Li Fu and his wife had already caused public outrage in Laoshu Village. The little daughter-in-law and the old aunt kept talking about all the bad things Li Fu and Wang Chunhua had done. Why are you stealing vegetables from your neighbor's garden? Stealing the hen that laid eggs at Sister-in-law Li's house. Drugging other people's dogs that watch the melon fields. Li Fu also stole scrap metal from the factory before. And Wang Chunhua likes to take advantage the most. Other married women always get good things from their husband's family to their natal family, but she is different. She always gets things from her own home. So much so that Father Wang has said that he will never see her parents' home again unless she celebrates the New Year, and even if she comes back, he will not let her in. This is equivalent to disowning this daughter. Who told her to steal the malted milk she bought for her nephew and give it to her son to drink? This is called deserved.
Now, there is no need for Tao Zexi to add insult to injury. This couple is so good. They really live up to that sentence. If they are not a family, they will not enter the same family.
As for Su Rui, when they arrived at the foot of the back mountain, they saw the isolated courtyard house, which made Su Rui feel like she had returned to the ancient capital full of legends.
The courtyard is not big, but it is very impressive. It looks very noble and majestic, making people want to look up at it.
Su Rui showed a nostalgic and painful look. Thinking of her deceased grandfather and her grandfather's love for her, her hatred for the Wu family deepened.
As for the middle-aged policeman who has never left Urumqi in his life, how can he understand the beauty of the courtyard house, so he just thinks this house is very beautiful.
Looking at this house, the middle-aged policeman became even more convinced.The old man looked back at Su Rui and said, "Let's go in." After that, without waiting for Su Rui's answer, he stepped forward and knocked on the door.
Dong-dong-dong, "Is anyone home? Someone..." Before he could finish speaking, the vermillion door opened.
"What are you knocking! I don't know, old man, that I am taking a nap. I disturb people's peace, so be careful of being punished by God!" the old man said angrily.
The middle-aged policeman looked embarrassed, "Ahem, old gentleman, I am policeman Wang Gui from the Qingmu County Police Station. I am here to see you..."
"Master! My parents passed away! You are the only relative I have, Master! Woohoo~" Before he could finish speaking, he saw a figure rushing over to hug the old man. "Master! Don't let me go! I will never be naughty again, master, master! Please~ I won't cause you any trouble, woo woo~"
The old man pushed Su Rui away, "I said, you girl, why are you so messed up..." Before he could finish his words, the old man showed a look of surprise when he saw Su Rui's face, and immediately changed his words, "It turns out you are the one who has the girl. What did you say? Your parents passed away? Hey, it seems that we, the master and the apprentice, can only depend on each other..."
Su Rui was surprised that the old man changed his face so quickly, and at the same time he breathed a sigh of relief, as long as he hadn't been exposed. But she could clearly see the surprise in the old man's eyes. What was it that made him so surprised?
"In this case, Su Rui will stay with your master for one night today. I will look at Tao Zexi's investigation results later. After this case is completed, I can take your parents' bodies back and bury them in peace. I won't go in." After that, the middle-aged policeman said goodbye to the old man respectfully and left. The pair of fake masters and disciples were left standing at the door with their eyes wide open.
－－－－－－Digression－－－－－
Finally met Master. But there were so few people who came to support me.
